#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct Position {
    int row, col;
    Position(int r=0, int c=0): row(r), col(c) {}
};

int delta_row[] = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
int delta_col[] = {0, -1, 1, 0};

int grid_size, time_limit;
char grid[12][12], grid1[12][12], grid2[12][12];
int dist1[12][12], dist2[12][12];

void compute_dist1(const Position& start) {
    memset(dist1, -1, sizeof(dist1));
    dist1[start.row][start.col] = 0;
    queue<Position> q;
    q.push(start);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Position current = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
            Position next(current.row + delta_row[k], current.col + delta_col[k]);
            if (grid[next.row][next.col] != '.') continue;
            if (dist1[next.row][next.col] < 0) {
                dist1[next.row][next.col] = dist1[current.row][current.col] + 1;
                q.push(next);
            }
        }
    }
}

void compute_dist2(const Position& start) {
    memset(dist2, -1, sizeof(dist2));
    dist2[start.row][start.col] = 0;
    queue<Position> q;
    q.push(start);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Position current = q.front(); q.pop();
        if (dist1[current.row][current.col] >= 0 && dist2[current.row][current.col] >= dist1[current.row][current.col]) continue;
        for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
            Position next(current.row + delta_row[k], current.col + delta_col[k]);
            if (grid[next.row][next.col] != '.') continue;
            if (dist2[next.row][next.col] < 0) {
                if (dist1[next.row][next.col] >= 0 && dist1[next.row][next.col] < dist2[current.row][current.col] + 1) continue;
                dist2[next.row][next.col] = dist2[current.row][current.col] + 1;
                q.push(next);
            }
        }
    }
}

struct MaxFlow {
    int size;
    vector<vector<int>> capacity, flow;
    vector<int> parent, level;

    MaxFlow(int n): size(n), capacity(n, vector<int>(n,0)), flow(n, vector<int>(n,0)), parent(n), level(n) {}

    void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        capacity[u][v] += cap;
    }

    int bfs(int s, int t, vector<int>& path) {
        fill(parent.begin(), parent.end(), -1);
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (u == t) {
                int min_cap = INT_MAX;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    min_cap = min(min_cap, capacity[parent[v]][v] - flow[parent[v]][v]);
                }
                path.clear();
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    path.push_back(v);
                }
                path.push_back(s);
                reverse(path.begin(), path.end());
                return min_cap;
            }
            for (int v=0; v<size; ++v) {
                if (parent[v] < 0 && capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int total = 0;
        vector<int> path;
        while (int push = bfs(s, t, path)) {
            for (size_t i=0; i+1<path.size(); ++i) {
                int u=path[i], v=path[i+1];
                flow[u][v] += push;
                flow[v][u] -= push;
            }
            total += push;
        }
        return total;
    }
};

    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> grid_size >> time_limit;
    memset(grid1, '#', sizeof(grid1));
    for (int r=1; r<=grid_size; ++r) {
        cin >> (grid1[r]+1);
        grid1[r][grid_size+1] = '#';
    }
    memset(grid2, '#', sizeof(grid2));
    for (int r=1; r<=grid_size; ++r) {
        cin >> (grid2[r]+1);
        grid2[r][grid_size+1] = '#';
    }
    memset(grid, '#', sizeof(grid));
    vector<Position> scientists, capsules;
    Position z;
    for (int r=1; r<=grid_size; ++r) {
        for (int c=1; c<=grid_size; ++c) {
            if (isdigit(grid1[r][c])) {
                if (grid1[r][c] > '0') scientists.emplace_back(r,c);
                grid[r][c] = '.';
            } else if (grid1[r][c]=='Z') {
                z = Position(r,c);
                grid[r][c] = '.';
            }
            if (isdigit(grid2[r][c]) && grid2[r][c]>'0') {
                capsules.emplace_back(r,c);
            }
        }
    }
    compute_dist1(z);
    int source=0;
    int sink= (int)scientists.size() + (int)capsules.size() + 1;
    MaxFlow mf(sink+1);
    for (int i=0; i<(int)scientists.size(); ++i) {
        mf.add_edge(source, i+1, grid1[scientists[i].row][scientists[i].col]-'0');
    }

        mf.add_edge((int)scientists.size()+j+1, sink, grid2[capsules[j].row][capsules[j].col]-'0');
    }

struct Network {
    int n;
    vector<vector<int>> capacity, flow;
    vector<int> parent, level;

    Network(int size): n(size), capacity(size, vector<int>(size,0)), flow(size, vector<int>(size,0)), parent(size), level(size) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        capacity[u][v] += c;
    }

    int bfs(int s, int t, vector<int>& path) {
        fill(parent.begin(), parent.end(), -1);
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s]=0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u=q.front(); q.pop();
            if (u==t) {
                int minCap=INT_MAX;
                for (int v=t; v!=s; v=parent[v]) {
                    minCap = min(minCap, capacity[parent[v]][v]-flow[parent[v]][v]);
                }
                path.clear();
                for (int v=t; v!=s; v=parent[v]) path.push_back(v);
                path.push_back(s);
                reverse(path.begin(), path.end());
                return minCap;
            }
            for (int v=0; v<n; ++v) {
                if (parent[v]<0 && capacity[u][v]-flow[u][v]>0) {
                    parent[v]=u;
                    level[v]=level[u]+1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int total=0;
        vector<int> p;

            for (size_t i=0; i+1<p.size(); ++i) {
                int u=p[i], v=p[i+1];
                flow[u][v]+=push;
                flow[v][u]-=push;
            }
            total+=push;
        }
        return total;
    }
};
